code.js: document.addEventListener('slide:activate', function(){ var els=document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'); els.forEach(function(el,i){ setTimeout(function(){ el.style.transition='all .8s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)'; el.style.opacity='1'; el.style.transform='translateY(0)'; }, 150+i*140); }); var o={v:0},el=document.getElementById('fps'); var id=setInterval(function(){ o.v+=7; if(o.v>=144){o.v=144;clearInterval(id)} el.textContent=Math.round(o.v); },30); });
